ResearchProjectDef.label: AEC Deacon
ResearchProjectDef.description: **AEC Deacon**\nA powerful turret designed to deliver devastating firepower on the battlefield. Utilizing 57mmOQF, this turret only fires directly at targets, making it a versatile addition to any defense network.\nThe AEC Deacon has a burst cooldown of 4.0s and a reload time of 1s per shell. With a max range of 90 and a minimum range of 4 (indirect: 1), it is effective at direct fire support only. It features a magazine size of 24, allowing for sustained engagements before reloading. Standard durability, able to withstand moderate fire.
